بعد از هر جواب، پیام بعدی احتمالی شما پی: After each answer your likely next message is suggested; Tab accepts it. Claude only, and each suggestion uses a little of your quota.
برگشتن پیشنهاد وقتی کادر خالی شد: Bring the suggestion back when the box empties
با تایپ کردن، پیشنهاد کنار می‌رود. این ک: Typing dismisses the suggestion. With this on, it returns once you clear the box, as in Claude Code.
وقتی سقف مصرف باز شد، گفتگوی نیمه‌تمام خ: When the usage limit reopens, an unfinished chat carries on by itself, at most three times in a row. Any message from you cancels it.
وقتی سقف یک موتور پر شد: When an engine hits its limit
Automatic: the chat moves to the next engine by itself. Ask: in your own chats a card comes first and nothing changes until you answer. Colleagues' chats and jobs always move by themselves.
در حالت برنامه، برنامه با یک کارت به شما: In plan mode the plan reaches you and Telegram as a card; «Approve plan» or typing برو, تأیید, مرج کن, go or approve starts the work, as in Karsara. Claude only. Applies to new chats or after a restart.
یک گفتگوی جدا کنار گفتگوی باز، با همان ز: A separate chat beside the open one, with the same context: ask something on the side without disturbing the main chat.
جستجوی کنار صفحه علاوه بر عنوان گفتگو، م: The sidebar search also looks through messages and answers, not only chat titles, as in Karsara.
همهٔ موتورها می‌توانند وب را بگردند و صف: Every engine can search the web and read pages. Web results count as third-party content, so they cannot auto-approve knowledge.
Chromium واقعی در سندباکس، برای تست سایت: A real Chromium in the sandbox, for testing sites and working in panels that have no API.
ایجنت کد یا اپ را در سندباکس اجرا می‌کند: The agent runs code or an app in the sandbox and shows its page right in the chat.
قبل از اجرای تغییرها یک بازبینی دوم انجا: A second review runs before changes are applied, so mistakes are caught before they take effect.
در گفتگوهای خود شما: فهرست و خواندن چت‌ه: In your own chats: list and read chats, message another chat (a chain of up to two hops) and ring your phone (once a minute). Never for colleagues or jobs.
این نصب خودش را به ایجنت‌های همکاران معر: This install introduces itself to colleagues' agents and talks to them. Turn it off on a test install beside your main one, so colleagues' work does not run twice.
یک گفتگو را از راه تلگرام با یک نفر به ا: Share one chat with one person through Telegram: an invite and a one-time code reach them, it opens on one device only and you can close it anytime. Turning this off pauses the links but does not close them.
فایل‌ها و نمودارهای یک پاسخ هم به تلگرام: An answer's files and charts are also sent to Telegram and Bale. Off: only the text, as in Karsara.
هر پیامی که از حساب تلگرام شما فرستاده م: Each message sent from your Telegram account is logged with the chat that sent it, so the reply returns there. Only your own chats read it.
دستیار: به جای شما جواب می‌دهد. صندوق: م: Assistant: it answers for you. Inbox: as in Karsara each message lands in an inbox chat and nothing reaches the colleague without you; the send ledger turns on by itself.
ترمینال، تنظیمات، مهارت‌ها و MCPهای شخصی: Terminal, settings, skills and personal MCPs beside Griffin's tools, in your own chats. Claude engine only. Never for colleagues; jobs only with the «your own jobs» option.
کانتینر: داخل کانتینر گریفین. روی سرور:: Container: inside Griffin's container. On the server: your own chats run as your user on the server, with your SSH key, kubectl, gh, git, skills and memory, like Claude Desktop. Everything else stays in the container. The server must be prepared for this (GRIFFIN_CLAUDE_HOST_TARGET).
ترمینال یا ایجنتی که در پس‌زمینه اجرا شد: A terminal or agent running in the background carries on after the answer ends. Each has a stop button in the chat, and its result reaches the next message.
پیامی که وسط کار می‌فرستید همان لحظه به: A message you send mid-run reaches that same answer at once, not after it ends.
Fable در فهرست مدل‌ها، بعد از Opus می‌آی: Fable appears in the model list after Opus, if your Claude plan includes it.
هر گفتگوی تازه و هر کار کوتاه (اسم چت، پ: Each new chat and each short job (chat titles, drafts, reviewers) goes to the healthy account with the most quota left; a chat stays there and moves only when that account fills or passes 85% while another is much emptier. Each account's quota is read every 15 minutes without spending tokens. Off: the old fixed order.
قفل تمدیدی را که از پردازهٔ مرده جا ماند: Clears a refresh lock left by a dead process and renews the token minutes before it expires, so runs do not stall on «another Claude Code process is refreshing it».
ترمینال و هر ابزار دیگر نمی‌تواند در انب: The terminal and every other tool cannot write to the knowledge store or the data folder (owner token, secret keys, database). Reading stays free.
ترمینال نمی‌تواند نام و ایمیل کامیت را خ: The terminal cannot pick a commit's name and email; a commit carries the git identity of whoever pushes it.
گفتگویی که از پیام تلگرام کس دیگری ساخته: A chat made from someone else's Telegram message cannot write your instruction files (CLAUDE.md, settings, memory, skills, hooks). Saved Messages and your own bot stay free.
هر ۱۵ دقیقه سلامت گریفین چک می‌شود و مشک: Griffin checks itself every 15 minutes and fixes known problems on its own.
شمارش اینکه کجای صفحه کلیک می‌شود، فقط ن: Counts where people click, only button and section names, never message text. Goes to the maintainer's install every hour, to find the most and least used parts.
یک بار، در پس‌زمینه و فقط وقتی کاری در ج: Once, in the background and only when nothing is running, the pieces of old answers are merged in the database. Big chats open faster and nothing they show changes; stored rows are rewritten.
چت‌های خود شما یک Chrome مشترک با صفحه‌ن: Your own chats share a Chrome with a screen in the sandbox that you can watch and use live; its logins stay.
در عنوان صفحه، ظاهر پیش‌فرض مرورگر تازه: Used in the page title, a new browser's default look and {product} in the signature.
Placed under messages the assistant sends. {name} is the assistant, {owner} is you, {product} is the product, e.g. «— {name}, {owner}'s assistant · {product}».
For chart and file links in messengers.
با ایمیل کامیت کامل می‌شود. خالی: کامیت‌: Goes with the commit email. Empty: commits carry the assistant's name.
مثلاً alex یعنی شاخه‌ها alex/<id> می‌شون: For example alex makes branches alex/<id>. Empty: the assistant's name.
The repo a new chat starts with.
فایل‌های ignore‌شدهٔ ریپو مثل .env یا ap: Ignored repo files such as .env or app.db, comma-separated, linked from the main folder into each new chat's worktree, as in Karsara. A repo can also carry a .worktreeinclude file.
بایگانی گفتگوی بی‌کار روی ریپو: Archive idle chats on a repo
بعد از این چند روز بی‌کاری بایگانی می‌شو: Archived after this many idle days. 0 means never; the default is 3.
The model that writes chat titles.
وقتی موتور OpenAI-compatible پر شد، این: This Claude model takes over when an OpenAI-compatible engine fills up.
حسابی که ایجنت همکاران روی شبکه با آن کا: The account colleagues' agents use on the network. Empty: as in the agent's profile.
مدلی که ایجنت همکاران با آن شروع می‌کنند: The model colleagues' agents start with.
How hard colleagues' agents think on the network.
اگر پیام همکار واقعاً کار بود، همان نوبت: If a colleague's message is real work, that turn moves to this stronger model in the same session, and the next message returns to the starting model. For example opus. Empty: off. Claude accounts only.
حسابی که رشته‌های همکاران با آن اجرا می‌: The account colleague threads run on.
حسابی که زیرکارهای رشتهٔ همکار با آن اجر: The account a colleague thread's subtasks run on.
The model for a colleague thread's subtasks.
آدرس SearXNG خودتان برای جستجو، مثل http: Your own SearXNG for search, like https://searx.example.com/search. Empty: DuckDuckGo with no key.
خودکار: سندباکس، مگر نصب روی هاست باشد و: Automatic: the sandbox, unless the install runs on the host with no sandbox. Sandbox: always the sandbox. On the machine: always the machine itself.
preview.example.com یعنی یک میزبان جدا ک: preview.example.com is a separate host that serves apps using /assets/… paths correctly. *.preview.example.com gives each preview a subdomain, the best option, and needs wildcard DNS and a certificate. Empty: on the same host, only for pages with relative addresses.
برای سایت‌های فیلترشده، مثل http://host:: For filtered sites, like http://host:port or socks5://host:port. Empty: direct, from the server's IP.
از کل پایگاه داده، هر شب به وقت سرور (GR: Of the whole database, every night, server time (GRIFFIN_TZ). 0 to 23; the default is 5; off turns it off.
پیش‌فرض ۸. جدا از این، آخرین بکاپ هر روز: The default is 8. Apart from these, each day's last backup stays for 7 days.
پیش‌فرض backups داخل پوشهٔ داده. برای ام: By default backups inside the data folder. For more safety give it another disk or mount.
آدرس باکت S3 شما و یک پوشه، مثل https://: Your S3 bucket and a folder, like https://s3.west.example.org/<bucket>/griffin-backup. With the secrets backup/s3-access-key, backup/s3-secret-key and backup/password (the restic password) each encrypted backup goes there too. Keep a copy of the password off this server. Empty: off.
نام یا شناسه، با ویرگول. خواندن و نوشتن: Names or ids, comma-separated. Reading or writing a secret in any other project asks you first. Empty: each project asks once per chat.
برای پرامپت راه‌اندازی می‌گوید دسترسی‌ها: Tells the setup prompt where the access lives, with no passwords. For example «server shell and owner token in Infisical project x, path /capsule».
معمولاً از «بازارچه» عوض می‌شود. خالی: پ: Usually changed from the marketplace. Empty: the product's default. all: everything. a,b: exactly these. default,-jobs,+tickets: the default without jobs and with tickets.
Off, record only, critical only, or shadow.
متنی که به ایجنت همکاران داده می‌شود. {u: The text given to colleagues' agents. {user} is the colleague's id.
هر یادداشتی که ایجنت می‌نویسد بی‌سؤال ذخ: Every note the agent writes is saved and approved without asking and reaches the chats; the knowledge page is only for deleting. Off by default.
اینتر: اینتر می‌فرستد و شیفت+اینتر خط بع: Enter: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a new line. Shift+Enter: Shift+Enter sends and Enter only adds a new line. On a touch phone Enter is always a new line.
عضو تازهٔ شبکهٔ ایجنت‌ها: New member of the agents' network
نصبی که روی دامنه‌های شرکت سلام می‌کند:: An install on a company domain that says hello: Automatic makes it a member at once; Owner's approval keeps it disabled and raises a «Waiting for you» card. Current members are not touched.
